Bay Area Chinese wedding DJ
Location: san mateo Marriott
Guests: 100
Date: Saturday, July 26, 2014
Times: 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM

San Mateo Marriott DJ


Ceremony Processional Song

Chinese Ceremony DJ


chinese mandarin bilingual wedding mc


Bouquet Toss


Cake Cutting and Toast.

Reception DJ – Music
1. Arrival of the Wedding Party Grand Entrance –

Announce –(We are still discussing the music and dance. We will talk to you as soon as possible. The following is just the draft.)
Mr & Mrs
Mr & Mrs
江一舟&秦语Bruno Mars – Marry me
王浩&陈鑫&赵彦 不醉 – 黄渤
花又開好了 Blossomy – S.H.E
迫不及待 – Can Not Wait S.H.E
筷子兄弟 – 小苹果

Newlyweds Applause
Mr Qing Sun & Mrs Jiani Zhang

2. 1st Dance – Shenqing Xiongyong and Sway (Keen will send the edited song to you tomorrow.)

Father/Daughter -异乡人-李健(need to confirm with our parents)

3. Wedding Jazz Background Type – Dinner Is Served-Dinner Music-

There are four songs that you have in your Chinese song list:
1. 陶喆 – 今天你要嫁给我
2. 王力宏 – Forever Love
3. 郁可唯 – 暖心
4. 邓丽君 – 月亮代表我的心
5. 張靚穎 – 終於等到你

Here are more Chinese songs we prefer:

5. 甜蜜蜜-邓丽君
Tian Mi Mi – Teresa Teng

6. 最美-羽泉
The most beautiful-Yu Quan

7. 最浪漫的事-赵咏华
The most romantic thing-Yonghua Zhao

8. 我愿意-王菲
I’m Willing – Faye Wong

9. 最重要的决定-范玮琪
The Most Important Decision – Fan Wei Qi

10. 遇见-孙燕姿
Yu Jian （Encounter) – Stefanie Sun

11. 天使-五月天
Angel – Mayday

12. 爱上你-SHE

13. 爱的就是你-王力宏Leehom Wang

14. 执子之手-品冠

15. 就是爱你-陶喆

16. Wanting 曲婉婷 – 爱的海洋 (Love Ocean)

17. 爱你不是两三天-梁静茹

18. 我爱你-SHE

19. 小手拉大手-梁静茹

20. Marry Me-萧敬腾

21. 风吹麦浪 -李健

22. Better Me -薛凱琪 Fiona Sit

23. wonderful tonight – 方大同MV

24. A.I.N.Y.-邓紫棋

25. Life Is Like A Song – Wanting 曲婉婷

26. Today – Wanting(曲婉婷)

27. Bruno Mars – Just The Way You Are

28. Love Me Tender – Elvis Presley

29. Love story – Taylor Swift

4. Toast Best Man Maid of Honor Speech …
Love Me Tender – Elvis Presley

5. Games
Runaway Baby – Bruno Mars
私奔到月球-五月天
简单爱-周杰伦Simple Love – Jay Chou
More speedy and popular English music need to be recommended

6. Bouquet Toss –
Single Ladies – Beyoncé (Gather all the single ladies to the front)
(Please recommend.)

7. Cake Cutting –
Wanting 曲婉婷 – Drenched

8. Dance Music – Dancing
(List dancing music here)
PSY – GANGNAM STYLE
无限大-孙燕姿
放轻松-张靓颖
Please recommend some popular English club music

9. Last Dance Song of the Night – Bride & Groom Thank There Guests
Tonight，I feel close to you-倉木麻衣 with 孫燕姿

Departure – Goodnight Sweetheart.

DO NOT PLAY.
